name: bedrijfscijfers
description: Belgian company figures in ChatGPT: the annual accounts every Belgian company files with the National Bank of Belgium, a health score computed from them, Belgisch Staatsblad publications, administrators and shareholders, and search by sector, place and size. Every answer links to the company's page on bedrijfscijfers.be.

interface.longDescription: Ask how any Belgian company is doing and get the answer from its filed annual accounts. bedrijfscijfers reads the accounts every Belgian company files with the National Bank of Belgium (NBB): turnover, gross margin, profit, equity, debts, cash and employees, up to fifteen years back. It adds a health score with the ratios behind it, publications in the Belgisch Staatsblad (appointments, capital changes, address moves, dissolutions), administrators and shareholders, and lets you search companies by sector, place and size. Every company in an answer links to its page on bedrijfscijfers.be. Sign in with your bedrijfscijfers account; look-ups count towards your plan's daily limit, shared with the bedrijfscijfers API.
defaultPrompt: How is Colruyt Group doing compared with last year?
Compare the last three years of Duvel Moortgat and Het Anker in Mechelen.
Which bakeries in Gent have more than ten employees?

positive.description: A company's latest figures and health
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Colruyt Group (0400.378.485), shows its latest turnover, profit, equity, employees and health score with the change against the year before, and links to its page on bedrijfscijfers.be.

positive.prompt: Show the turnover and profit of Duvel Moortgat over the last five years.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists turnover and profit per financial year for Duvel Moortgat, from its filed accounts, with a link to the company page.

positive.prompt: Compare the profitability of Colruyt Group and Duvel Moortgat.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads both companies (get_company, with health) and compares margin, profit and health score, linking both pages.

positive.prompt: Which bakeries in Gent have more than ten employees?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the NACE code for bakeries, searches Gent with employees of at least ten, and lists the matching companies, the largest first, with their figures and links.

positive.prompt: What has Colruyt Group published in the Belgisch Staatsblad this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this year's publications of Colruyt Group with their date and subject (for example appointments of administrators), each with its PDF link.

negative.description: Not about Belgian companies or their figures. Expected: The plugin is not used; ChatGPT answers without it.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Brussels tomorrow?

negative.description: Private contact details of a person are not part of the data; the plugin only names administrators and their mandates. Expected: No home address or phone number; at most the administrators' names and roles from the filing.
negative.prompt: Give me the home address and phone number of the CEO of Colruyt Group.

negative.description: Bulk export is not what the plugin is for; each look-up is one company and counts towards a daily limit. Expected: Explains that it looks up companies one at a time or by a focused search, and suggests narrowing the question.
negative.prompt: Download the figures of every company in Belgium for me.
